layouts.description: Draft configuration: Organizer published A+B+C plan identifies the western S loops, southern diagonal return and eastern mushroom loop. The long northern runway loop, eastern circular loop, rectangular shortcut and access fork are excluded. Exact independent source nodes form this draft course; measured course distance, fine alignment, travel direction and historical timing correspondence remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3225.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
